summary: Diff adds a migration stub, a frontend backend-error-to-English-message mapper, and updates Header/Profile UI and React Query invalidations. However, the diff summary does not provide enough evidence that the backend Level progression rules and avatar persistence are correctly implemented end-to-end; several core REQ-23/REQ-24 behaviors cannot be verified from the shown changes. There are also unrequested branding changes ("Scholar Gold" and new logo usage) evident in the frontend modifications.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix the Level system end-to-end so progression has no glitch (5 ranks per level number, Level 1 Noob free, paid upgrades cost 50, only immediate next stage purchasable, max Level 50 Sigma Student), including backend rules + frontend max-level/upgrade enablement and refresh after purchase.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not show any concrete backend implementation for computing current/next level stages, enforcing sequential purchase, coin cost rules, or returning a clear max-level error. backend/main.mo is truncated before any level functions/state are shown, so the required logic changes cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add/fix user avatar support so uploading a profile photo persists to the backend and reliably renders after reload/log out + log in, with fallback and English error messages.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend shows avatar rendering from profile.profileImage.getDirectURL() and a save flow that converts a File to ExternalBlob, but the diff summary provides no evidence that backend updateCallerProfile/getCallerUserProfile persist and return the image across sessions/reloads. Also the ProfileSection error-handling code is truncated mid-line, so the final user-facing error behavior cannot be verified.

hallucinated_features.description: App branding changes to "Scholar Gold" and new logo usage in Header (and implied broader branding changes).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is focused on Level progression and avatar persistence; it does not request renaming/rebranding or changing header branding assets/text.

hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest allows introducing backend/migration.mo only if required to preserve existing stable state; the diff shows a migration module added but provides no evidence that a state migration was necessary or that any state shape changed requiring it.
